g.text: CBR / LOW_100 / historical Radiance baseline, superseded
GENERIC / PROVISIONAL / NOT MEASURED / NOT PRODUCT VALIDATION
Workplane 0.75 m; MF 0.8; 100% stored output; 0.25 ft source grid
Plan x / ft; plan z increases down the page. Blank cells are outside the source mask.
P1 excluded; pooja strip/spot and KIT-L1 cove remain HELD. No fixtures moved.
Curtain strips have no lux credit. UTL/BAL assume enclosure, not real open-air conditions.
HISTORICAL CBR: geometry and LOW are superseded; use current review heatmaps.
Viewer/workbench maps remain separate frozen analytic estimates, not this ray-tracing result.
Source: analysis/sim-heatmaps.json. Values are supplied rounded lux; no lighting recalculated.
